posts.title: The little iPod that could
posts.description: As a child I was never what you’d call “athletic” or “sporty”, I was more “gangly and uncoordinated”. I always dreaded PE, doubly so when it was cross country running. I never even tried. My friends and I were always the ones walking for the whole session, we never made around the entire course.

posts.title: Reducing Screen time by 86%
posts.description: “How long is left on this?” I asked, referring to the TV show my wife was currently watching, in which I didn’t have much interest.

posts.title: The Joy of Aeroplane Mode Programming
posts.description: Recently I got back to the basics of programming - just me, a computer, and a book - it was fantastic. No internet. No distractions.
